title: renderContracts
responsibility: Formats full contracts, compact lists, ranked matches and relationship maps as readable terminal text.

inputs.name: renderContracts.operation
inputs.description: One of show, list, search or map, selecting the text layout for the corresponding result shape.

inputs.name: renderContracts.result
inputs.description: The matching result payload: full records for show, summaries for list, scored matches for search or a ContractMap for map.

outputs.name: renderContracts
outputs.description: Readable terminal text. List/search use one row per result; show retains full stored fields; map separates roots, directions and unresolved ids.

errors.name: TypeError
errors.description: Malformed direct-call result data does not match the requested operation layout.

errors.name: RangeError
errors.description: Cyclic or excessively nested direct-call objects can exceed recursive text rendering depth; CLI stored JSON is acyclic.
